description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy of Rs. 50 per Egg on Importation of Eggs. This Order valid for a period of 03 months from 21.05.2023
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the imposition and modification of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It involves the creation of a regulatory framework for taxation on a specific imported commodity (eggs), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it names the Minister of Finance, this is done in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not to announce a personnel change or describe detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about establishing and amending a legal charge on imports, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
